title: ToolMapping
description: Structured mapping of portable pstack capabilities to host-native agent harness tools and execution conventions.

file_read.description: Host primitive to read files (e.g. view_file, read_file).

file_edit.description: Host primitive to edit existing files (e.g. replace_file_content, edit_file).

file_write.description: Host primitive to create or overwrite files (e.g. write_to_file).

shell_run.description: Host primitive to execute terminal commands (e.g. run_command, bash).

web_fetch.description: Host primitive to fetch remote URL content (e.g. read_url_content, curl).

web_search.description: Host primitive to perform web searches (e.g. search_web).

agent_spawn.description: Host primitive to spawn child subagents (e.g. invoke_subagent, spawn_subagent, spawn_agent).

agent_fanout.description: Host convention for parallel fanout (e.g. N Subagents array items, N spawn_subagent in one turn).

agent_join.description: Host primitive to join, wait, or receive subagent output (e.g. manage_subagents, wait_agent, get_command_or_subagent_output).

agent_message.description: Host primitive for direct inter-agent messaging (e.g. send_message).

task_background.description: Host primitive for background tasks and timers (e.g. manage_task, schedule, background_job).

tool_mcp.description: Host primitive for Model Context Protocol server interaction (e.g. call_mcp_tool).

plan_update.description: Host primitive or artifact convention to update task plans (e.g. todo.md, todo_write).

human_ask.description: Host primitive to ask user questions (e.g. ask_question, ask_user_question).
